layout.arrangement: A single title slide. The slide canvas is a large light-gray rectangle with a thin crimson/red outline, inset from the white video margins (roughly 6%–94% of image width, 8%–96% of image height). The two-line title is centered horizontally in the upper-middle of the gray canvas (first line 'Revision of' at ~38% of image height, second line 'Perceptron Algorithm' at ~52%). A small yellow rounded badge containing the slide number '2' sits in the extreme top-right corner of the gray canvas, just inside the red border. A solid black horizontal bar runs along the very bottom of the image, slightly wider than the gray slide frame.

regions.name: Outer white margin
regions.position: full image, surrounding the slide frame (left ~0–6%, right ~94–100%, top ~0–8%, bottom ~96–100%)
regions.content: Plain white background of the video frame outside the slide.

regions.name: Slide canvas with red border
regions.content: Light-gray filled rectangle outlined by a thin crimson/red 1–1.5 px border.

regions.name: Title block
regions.content: Two centered lines of bold red text: 'Revision of' / 'Perceptron Algorithm'.

regions.name: Slide-number badge
regions.content: Small pale-yellow rounded rectangle with a purple outline containing the purple numeral '2'.

regions.name: Bottom black bar
regions.content: Solid black horizontal strip (video/player bar) spanning the bottom of the image.

layout.hierarchy: The bold red two-line title dominates by size, weight and central placement against the neutral light-gray field. The tiny yellow/purple '2' badge is the only secondary element (top-right), and the thin red frame plus the black bottom bar are the lowest-contrast structural elements.

visual_elements.description: Slide-number badge: a small horizontally-oriented rounded rectangle (pill/oval-like corners) filled pale yellow, outlined with a thin purple/blue-violet stroke, containing the single centered numeral '2' in purple/blue-violet. No other text or graphics.
visual_elements.position: top-right corner of the slide, just inside the red border (~x 803–840 px, y 50–82 px in a 900×506 image)

visual_elements.description: Slide frame: a thin (≈1–1.5 px) crimson/red rectangular outline enclosing the entire light-gray slide area; the line is uniform on all four sides.
visual_elements.position: perimeter of the slide canvas (~x 54–846 px, y 39–485 px)

visual_elements.description: Solid black horizontal bar (video player/letterbox strip) running along the very bottom of the image, extending slightly beyond the left and right edges of the red slide frame.
visual_elements.position: bottom of image (~x 35–865 px, y 485–506 px)

imagery: No photographs, icons or illustrations. The only graphic marks are the small yellow rounded slide-number badge with purple outline and numeral '2' in the top-right, the thin red rectangular border around the slide, and the black bar at the bottom of the video frame.
typography_notes: All text is a clean sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). The title is bold (heavy weight), red, centered, and split across two lines with generous line spacing; estimated ~32–36 pt at slide scale, with 'Revision of' on line 1 and 'Perceptron Algorithm' on line 2 (line 2 slightly wider). The badge numeral '2' is a small regular-weight purple character (~12–14 pt) centered in the yellow badge. No bullets, italics, underlines, all-caps styling, or other emphasis.
animation_state: Nothing appears mid-build; the slide is a static title/divider slide with the full title and the slide-number badge already visible.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide (e.g., 13.333 in × 7.5 in) and set the surrounding video/frame area to white; the slide content area itself is a light-gray (#E9E9E9) rectangle inset from the edges (about 6% of width on each side, 8% of height at top and 4% at bottom). 2. Draw a thin crimson/red (#C00000) rectangular outline, ~1–1.5 pt, around the entire light-gray rectangle. 3. Add a centered text box in the upper-middle of the gray area (vertical center around 45% of slide height) with two lines of bold Arial/Helvetica text in #C00000 at roughly 32–36 pt: line 1 'Revision of', line 2 'Perceptron Algorithm'; set paragraph alignment to center and line spacing to ~1.2, with a blank-line gap between the two lines. 4. In the top-right corner, just inside the red border (about 0.3 in from the right edge and 0.2 in from the top), insert a small rounded rectangle about 0.5 in wide × 0.45 in tall, fill #FFFF99, outline #6633CC at ~1 pt, and type the numeral '2' centered inside in #6633CC, regular weight, ~12–14 pt. 5. Add a solid black (#000000) horizontal rectangle along the very bottom of the video frame, spanning about 92% of the image width and ~4% of its height, slightly wider than the red slide frame. 6. Leave the rest of the slide empty — no bullets, charts, equations, logos, or footers.
